name: Bosch Industriekessel
description: Bosch's industrial boiler business (Gunzenhausen/Loisach, Germany): universal steam shells (UL-S/UL-SX, ZFR, CSB, U-MB), the electric steam boiler ELSB, hot-water Unimat lines, plus waste-heat recovery boilers and boiler-house modules, controls and service from a single source.

sources.note: Bosch ELSB electric steam boiler product page, read 30 October 2026

products: ELSB electric steam boiler (350-8,300 kg/h, up to 24 bar)
Universal steam boiler UL-S/UL-SX, ZFR/ZFR-X, CSB, U-MB
Self-fired waste heat boilers and HRSB heat-recovery steam boiler
